name: Galbot
desc: Chinese humanoid robotics startup developing general-purpose embodied robots, backed by Meituan, BAIC, CATL Capital and China Mobile funds.
capacity_detail: Seed USD 98M (Jun 2024) + USD 70M (Nov 2024) + Series B USD 154M (Jun 2025) + Series C USD 294M (Dec 2025) + Series D+ USD 350M (Mar 2026)
markets: Mainly China, where it develops and deploys general-purpose humanoid robots with industrial and state-backed investors.

signals.raise: Series D+ USD 350M led by National AI Industry Investment Fund (Mar 2026; https://newmarketpitch.com/blogs/news/humanoid-robotics-list-deals)
signals.ipo: Reportedly filed confidentially for a Hong Kong IPO (2026; https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3945918962898569)

rationale: Close to USD 1bn raised and IPO preparation; F1 showcase could build global brand credibility for its humanoids against Western rivals.

name: AgiBot
desc: Shanghai humanoid robot maker founded in 2023 by former Huawei engineers, producing industrial and service robots at scale.
capacity_detail: Valued at USD 2.1bn in a Series B led by Tencent Investment (Mar 2025); about USD 314M raised in total
markets: China-based with humanoid certifications in China, the United States and the European Union; deploys robots in manufacturing and logistics.

signals.ipo: Confirmed preparation for a Hong Kong listing (2026; https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3945918962898569)

rationale: Mass-producing humanoids with US and EU certification; F1 technology platform could support export ambitions and pre-IPO brand profile.

name: Leju Robotics
desc: Chinese humanoid robot developer that raised growth funding from Shenzhen state-linked investors and has applied for a ChiNext listing.
capacity_detail: Series D+ USD 28M (Jun 2025) + growth equity about USD 210M led by Shenzhen Investment Holdings Capital (Oct 2025)
markets: Mainly China, developing humanoid robots with backing from Shenzhen government-linked investment funds.

signals.ipo: ChiNext IPO application accepted by Shenzhen Stock Exchange (May 2026; https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3945918962898569)

rationale: Pre-IPO humanoid developer seeking visibility; F1 engineering association could help differentiate it in a crowded Chinese robotics market.

name: PaXini Tech
desc: Chinese humanoid robotics company backed by JD.com, Enn Capital and BOC International, raising repeatedly through 2025 and 2026.
capacity_detail: USD 14M+ (Apr 2025) + Series A USD 28M (Aug 2025) + Series B USD 145M+ (Mar 2026) + about USD 146M (Aug 2026)
markets: Mainly China, where it supplies humanoid robotics technology with backing from JD.com and state-linked investors.

signals.raise: About USD 146M led by BOC International Investment (Aug 2026; https://newmarketpitch.com/blogs/news/humanoid-robotics-list-deals)

rationale: Fast-growing, well-funded robotics supplier; F1 precision and sensing narrative fits a tactile and humanoid technology brand.

name: Anyverse Dynamics
desc: Chinese embodied AI and humanoid robotics startup that raised one of the largest seed rounds in its sector.
capacity_detail: Seed USD 42M (Nov 2025) + USD 28M+ (Feb 2026) + USD 200M+ led by JD.com, Hony Capital and others (Jun 2026)
markets: China, developing embodied AI robots with investors including HongShan China, JD.com and Hony Capital.

signals.raise: Seed extension USD 200M+ from JD.com, C Capital and Hony Capital (Jun 2026; https://newmarketpitch.com/blogs/news/humanoid-robotics-list-deals)

rationale: Heavily funded early-stage robotics brand needing recognition; F1 platform could raise its profile with partners and future investors.

name: Youibot
desc: Chinese maker of mobile manipulation robots combining autonomous chassis and collaborative arms for semiconductor and battery factories.
capacity_detail: Series D+ USD 193M (Jun 2024) + USD 9.8M and USD 30M (Jul 2025)
markets: Industrial customers in semiconductor, energy chemical, lithium battery and 3C electronics manufacturing, mainly in China.

signals.ipo: Second Hong Kong listing application under Rule 18C (Mar 2026; https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3945918962898569)

rationale: B2B automation brand heading to IPO; F1 hospitality and engineering story could support sales to global electronics manufacturers.

name: AI2 Robotics
desc: Chinese robotics company scaling manufacturing of its AlphaBot 2 humanoid robot for commercial deployments.
capacity_detail: Seed USD 14M+ (Jan 2025) + Series A USD 45M+ (Sep 2025) + Series B USD 140M+ (Feb 2026)
markets: China, scaling AlphaBot 2 production and commercial deployments with backing from Shenzhen Capital Group.
rationale: Rapidly funded humanoid maker scaling production; motorsport association could help showcase reliability to commercial buyers.

name: DJI
desc: Shenzhen-based drone maker holding over 90 percent of the global consumer drone market, also making cameras and stabilisers.
markets: Worldwide, with divisions in China, Japan, North America, Europe and Latin America and 17 international offices.
rationale: Global consumer tech brand whose cameras suit F1 content creation; US restrictions on Chinese drones may limit sponsorship appeal.

name: Alpitronic
desc: Bolzano-based maker of Hypercharger high-power DC fast chargers for electric vehicles, with about 135,000 charge points installed.
capacity_detail: Revenue about EUR 1bn in 2025 (infobox; text says just under EUR 1bn)
markets: Hyperchargers installed in 62 countries; about 30 percent European market share, with offices in Germany, Italy, UK and USA.
rationale: European EV-charging leader expanding in the US and UK; F1 hybrid and fast-charging technology story suits its high-power brand.

name: Ceer Motors
desc: Saudi electric vehicle brand formed by PIF and Foxconn in 2022, launching sedans and SUVs for GCC markets.
capacity_detail: Owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund; launched with two EVs in 2026 and plans seven models by 2030
markets: Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region, selling electric sedans and SUVs from a Saudi manufacturing base.
rationale: PIF-built national car brand launching in 2026; F1 and the Saudi Arabian Grand Prix offer immediate regional brand awareness.

name: EVIQ
desc: Saudi electric vehicle fast-charging network, a PIF and Saudi Electricity Company joint venture targeting over 5,000 charging points.
ownership: state fund: Public Investment Fund (PIF), joint venture with Saudi Electricity Company
capacity_detail: Joint venture of the Public Investment Fund and Saudi Electricity Company building more than 5,000 charging points
markets: Saudi Arabia: 11 cities, 56 locations and 134 chargers so far, with partners including Darb Fuel and Roads Authority.
rationale: State-backed charging brand needing public awareness as Saudi EV adoption grows; Jeddah Grand Prix tie-in could drive visibility.

name: TAILG
desc: Chinese electric bicycle and electric motorcycle maker, third in its home market, which sold 7.8 million vehicles in nine months.
capacity_detail: Revenue CNY 13.6bn (about USD 2bn) in 2024; CNY 14.8bn in first nine months of 2025
markets: China through about 5,600 distributors and 27,000 retail outlets, plus over 700 overseas sales points.

signals.ipo: Filed for Hong Kong IPO with CITIC Securities and China Merchants Securities International (Feb 2026; https://www.caixinglobal.com/2026-02-04/electric-two-wheeler-maker-tailg-files-for-hong-kong-ipo-102411155.html)

rationale: Mass-market EV brand facing share pressure at home and growing overseas; F1 exposure could lift premium positioning and exports.
